button.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors
button.secondary: bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-800 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors
button.success: bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors

input.default: w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent
input.error: w-full px-3 py-2 border border-red-300 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 focus:border-transparent

card.default: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-6 border border-gray-200
card.elevated: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200
